targets.query: from(bucket: "shuffler") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "telemetry") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "heatsink_c" or r["_field"] == "T1" or r["_field"] == "T2" or r["_field"] == "T3") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
